description: This file is a handler module for interacting with the Anthropic Claude-3 model via Google Cloud's Vertex AI platform. It defines error handling, configuration class, and request/response transformation methods tailored for Vertex AI's Anthropic API interface.

classes.name: VertexAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling HTTP errors related to Vertex AI interactions.

classes.name: VertexAIAnthropicConfig
classes.description: Configuration subclass defining the special parameters and request/response transformation methods for using the Claude-3 model via Vertex AI.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the string 'vertex_ai' indicating the provider name.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the request data to match Vertex AI's Anthropic API expectations, including handling special beta headers based on tools and settings.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response into a ModelResponse, setting the model attribute.

methods.name: bool is_supported_model(cls, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given model string is supported by the Vertex AI Anthropic interface.
